title: Phloem Unloading, Sink Strength and Whole-Plant Assimilate Partitioning
word_count_method: Saved HTML p.teaching-prose only, whitespace-separated; excludes questions, references, figures, tables and navigation.

coverage_matrix.concept: Root, young leaf, fruit, seed unloading and transitions
Sink strength, storage and carbon turnover
Quantitative pressure, transport energetics and mass balance
Tracer techniques, controls, stable isotope and perturbations
Mobile proteins, RNAs, hormonal and sugar signals
Cambial allocation and whole-plant water-carbon coupling

scientific_review: Internal scientific review compared official syllabus and research on root unloading, SWEET-mediated seed filling, tuber developmental transitions, cell-wall invertase, pressure flow and mobile FT/miR399. Distinguished flux from pool size, unloading from subsequent uptake, tissue/development context and conditional gradients. Independently recalculated osmotic and pressure differences, advective delivery, proton electrochemical energy, Péclet number, flow resistance, root allocation, enzyme rates, carbon retention and harvest index. All 50 answer texts matched their keyed option after Q10 correction.
editorial_review: Separate review expanded integrated map, cambial allocation and stable-isotope tracing; corrected graph overlap, mature source leaf label and question option mismatch; shuffled questions, checked saved prose uniqueness, tag balance, anchor links, SVG labels and accessibility attributes. Compared 14,380 teaching words with 13,653-word approved auxin exemplar.
deductions: Scientific: models simplified, no external peer review; pedagogy: dense quantitative content; diagrams: schematic and static inspection only; assessment: original uncalibrated questions; reader: runtime mobile, keyboard and screen-reader interactions untested.
